theme: 美股·板块与地域收入分布：谷歌A财年收入结构拆解（板块占比/地域收入），话题切换至波音全年营收
question: 再把最新披露财年它在各地域的销售收入从高到低拉个清单
first_sql: SELECT m.CSNAME AS `股票名称`, m.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, v.F001D AS `财政周期结束日期`, v.F005V AS `货币`, v.F006V AS `地域英文`, v.REGION_CNAME AS `地域中文`, ROUND(v.F007N / 100, 3) AS `销售收入/亿` FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m INNER JOIN VIEW_COM3106 v ON m.FIU_ID = v.FIU_ID WHERE m.COMB_SYMBOL = 'GOOGL.US' AND v.F001D = (SELECT MAX(v2.F001D) FROM VIEW_COM3106 v2 WHERE v2.FIU_ID = m.FIU_ID) AND v.F007N IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.F007N DESC
